items.title: Nutcracker Front and Open Back Views
items.alt: Front and rear views of a blue wooden nutcracker, showing a long jaw lever beneath a removed back panel.
items.description: Two views show the same blue toy's painted front and open wooden back. The rear view reveals a simple long lever, while the removed blue cover rests beside the boots.

items.title: Nutcracker on a Rocking Horse
items.alt: Green-jacketed nutcracker riding a chestnut wooden rocking horse with gold-trimmed curved rockers.
items.description: A small red-capped nutcracker sits above a pale saddle blanket and holds the reins. The chestnut horse's raised legs and long curved rockers form one sweeping toy silhouette.

items.title: Woodland Nutcracker with an Acorn Basket
items.alt: Woodland nutcracker wearing a wide orange mushroom hat and leaf-trimmed green coat, carrying an acorn basket.
items.description: A wide mushroom-shaped hat shades the woodland figure's dark painted face. Layered leaf trim, a bark-edged base and a basket of acorns give the toy a forest theme.

items.title: Sailor Nutcracker on a Sea Chest
items.alt: Blue-coated sailor nutcracker seated on a sea chest with a thick rope coil over one knee.
items.description: The sailor sits squarely on a metal-trimmed wooden chest with both boots apart. A navy cap, double-breasted coat and heavy rope coil distinguish the seated figure.

items.title: Squirrel Lever Nutcracker
items.alt: Bronze-colored squirrel nutcracker tool with a raised tail lever and walnut in its front cradle.
items.description: A raised squirrel tail forms the tool's long lever above a visible side pivot. A walnut sits in the front cradle, with a loose nut and split shell beside the wooden base.

items.title: Brass Screw Nutcracker
items.alt: Brass screw nutcracker pressing a walnut in a rounded cup, resting on a folded cream napkin.
items.description: A threaded brass screw descends from a wide turning handle toward a walnut in a curved cup. Shell fragments and a small hazelnut rest on the folded napkin below.
